paite: Lungmuan un, ka mite lungmuan un, na Pathian un achi hi.
heading: Lametna Thute
english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

paite: Jerusalem kiang ah lungmuan lam sang in thu gen unla, agaldouna uh hihzoh ahita a, akhelhna uh ngaihdam ahi a, athilhihkhelh teng gun ding in TOUPA khut a kipan amun nih in amuta uh chih hilh un.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

paite: Tua! Kikou aw in, "Gamdai ah TOUPA lampi bawl unla, gamkeu ah i Pathian a ding in lamlian kilualsak un.
english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

paite: Guam chih sansak ahi vek ding a, tang chih mual chih niamsak ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, aphokna lailai hihlual ahi ding hi;
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

paite: TOUPA thupina hihlat ahi ding a, mi tengteng in huai amu chiat ding uh chih TOUPA kam in lah agenta ngal a," achi hi.
english: The glory of Yahweh shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Tua aw in, "Kikou in," achi hi. Mi'n, "Bang gen in ka kikou dia?” achi hi. Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina tengteng uh leng lou a pak bang ahi.
english: The voice of one saying, “Cry!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

paite: "TOUPA hu in amut ziak in loupa avuai a, apak atul nak; mite zaw loupa bang ahi mahmah uhi.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

paite: Loupa avuai a, apak atul zel; i Pathian thu bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding," chi in achi a.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

paite: Zion kiang a atanchinhoih hilh mi aw, tang sang mahmahte ah va hohtou in; Jerusalem kiang a tanchinhoih hilh mi aw, ngaihtak in na aw suah in; suah in, lau ke'n; Judah khuate kiang ah, "En un, na Pathian uh!”
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength. Lift it up. Don’t be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

paite: "En un, Toupa PATHIAN mihattak bang in ahong pai ding hi; aban in vai ahawm ding; En un, akipahman akiang ah a-om a, ditna leng ama ah a-om.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

paite: Ama'n belamchingpa bang in abelamhonte avak ding a, belamnoute aban in apomkhawm ding a, a-angsung a koih in apaipih ding a, nou kailaite bel awlawl in api hiathiat ding," chi in.
english: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

paite: Kua'n ahia tuite akhutpek sung lel ateh a, tung a van khap lel ateh a, lei a leivui tehna khat lel a thun vek a, tangte lah khaina a khai a, mual pawngte bukna lel a buk?
heading: Midang Toh Teh Vual Louh Israel' Pathian
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

paite: Kua'n ahia TOUPA kha thilhih dan ding kawkmuh? Ahihkeileh kua ahia amah lemsehsak hi a amah chil?
english: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahweh, or has taught him as his counselor?

paite: Ama'n kua adong a, kua'n ahia amah theisak a, vaihawm lampi ensak a, theihna hilh a, theihsiamna lampi ensak ngei?
english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

paite: Ngai in, namte lah baltin a tui tak khat bang lel ahi ua, bukna a banghiam nen bang lel a seh ahi ua, ngai in, ama'n tuikulh gamte thil neu neuchikte bang in adom zel hi.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

paite: Lebanon nangawn khul tham ahi kei a, agam a gante leng halmang a kithoihna tham ahi sam kei hi.
english: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

paite: Nam chihte lah ama ah bangmah lou bang ahi ua, amah ngaihtuah in bangmah lou sang a tawm zaw, huihkhua lel ahi uhi.
english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

paite: Pathian kua toh teh na hi ua? Ahihkeileh, bang lim ahia amah toh na teh ding uh?
english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

paite: Milim bawltawm zaw, nasem mi in asung a, dangka-eng sekmi'n dangka- eng in aluan khum a, huai a ding in dangka khainiangte asunsak zel hi.
english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

paite: Huchibang thilpiak pe zou lou a, genthei lo mahmah in sing muat lou ding atel zel, milim bawltawm, ling lou ding, amah a dia bawlkhiaksak ding khutsiam mi azong zel hi.
english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up an engraved image for him that will not be moved.

paite: Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za kei ua hia? Atung a kipan in hon hilh kei ua hia? Lei pianchil a pan na theisiam kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard, yet? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

paite: Amah zaw lei kualkhumna tung a tupa ahi, ama mitmuh in leitung a omte khaupe bang lel ahi uh, amah zaw tung a van puanin tung bang a kaipalh a, omna ding a puanin zak a, miliante bangmah lou suaksakpa ahi.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;

paite: Amah leitung a vaihawm mite bangmah lou a bawl nakpa ahi.
english: who brings princes to nothing; who makes the judges of the earth like meaningless.

paite: Ahi, suan ahi kei ua; ahi, tuh ahi sam kei uh; ahi, akung un lei ah zung akai kei; huai lou in ama'n amau amut a, avuai ua, pingpei in buhsi alakmang bang in alamang hi.
english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

paite: Kua toh hon teh a, kua kimpih a hon sep na hi ua? Mi Siangthou in achi hi.
english: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

paite: Tunglam ah na mit uh hak unla, huai thilte kua siam ahia en un; ama'n sepaihte kizomzom in apikhia a, amin chiat un asam a; ahatna thupina ziak leh thilhihtheihna a ahat ziak in khat mah leng kim lou a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. by the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, Not one is lacking.

paite: Jakobte aw, bang achia hiai chi na hi ua, Israelte aw, bang achia hichibang a thu gen na hi ua, "Ka lampi zaw TOUPA lak a sel ahi a, avai hawmsakna ka Pathian lak a lakmang ahi," chih?
english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God?”

paite: Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? Tangtawn Pathian, TOUPA kawlmong Siampa, abah louh a, agim ngeilouhdan; atheihsiamdan zonkhiak vual ahi kei hi.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

paite: Bahte kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, hatna himhim neiloute ahatsak naknak hi.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

paite: Tuailaite nangawn leng bah in agim ding ua, tangvalte leng apukzou ding uh.
english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

paite: TOUPA ngakte'n zaw ahatna uh athaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlai bang in kha in alengtou ding ua; gim lou in atai ding ua; bah lou in khe in apai ding uhi.
english: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
